title: Revert scope request
description: Planned (basalt_meta version 19, owner decision RS-2). The body of POST /api/v1/reverts/{revertId}/scope, which the revert page sends to the engine that served it, on loopback or inside a Vault link session, under the link's secret. Without proof: a narrow, inside the agent's own work, or inside the person's last proven select when the engine holds its scope token. With proof and newSecret: a widen beyond the agent's own work. Byte fields are base64url without padding. See CONTRACT.md, Revert, Rescope, widen and reject.

select.description: The scope the person wants. Postgres normalizes it; the widen proof signs the normalized text.

proof.description:
The widen proof: a WebAuthn assertion by the person's passkey whose challenge is sha256(utf8("basalt-rescope.1
" + revertId + "
" + nonce + "
" + hex(sha256(rescopeKey)) + "
" + normalized select)), with nonce the request's rescopeNonce as base64url and rescopeKey = HKDF-SHA-256(ikm newSecret, salt empty, info "basalt-rescope-key.1", 32 bytes).

newSecret.description: The link secret the revert has after the widen: 16 random bytes the page made (crypto.getRandomValues), base64url, 22 characters. Sent only to the engine; the engine passes Postgres only rescopeKey, derived from it, and never logs or stores it (it keeps sha256(newSecret), linkToken and psk as for any link).
